confession.text:
First Confession and First Holy Communion
Parents who wish to have their children receive these sacraments in our parish must enrol them in our catechetical sessions which takes place on Sundays (10.45 am - 12.00 pm). Typically, those at Levels 3 (ie. 9 years old) would be prepared at catechism sessions so that they are ready to receive the Sacraments of Reconciliation and Eucharist.
​
Please contact the catechetical ministry for enquiries.
Email: qopcatechism@gmail.com

sacraments.text: First Saturday of odd-numbered months, subject to liturgical changes; confirm date/time with office. Parents/godparents attend pre-baptism instructions. Download form and instruction letter, attach relevant documents and submit at office.
Arrange at least 12 months in advance; email Parish Office.
For Prayer Hall availability, WhatsApp text only, no phone calls.
Approach priests/office when seriously ill; do not wait until critically ill or death imminent. Parish also links nearby-hospital priest contacts.
Enrol children in Sunday catechism 10:45–12:00. Level 3 (typically age 9) prepares for First Reconciliation and Communion.
